# Treat native background tasks as a lifecycle contract

## Platform difference

Dart timers, SSH keepalive packets and a playing widget do not themselves request continued execution from OH.

## Implementation

LocalSend and Pica Comic pair transfer-queue state with native dataTransfer task start/stop. ConnSSH connects SSH lifecycle to a native task and live-view notification. Kazumi adds audio-service integration, the ability background mode, permission and interruption handling together. Simple Live also manages AVSession metadata and play/pause commands. PiliPlus initially supplies a custom plugin, later replaced in its snapshot by an audio-service-based design.

## Applicability

Choose a background mode corresponding to the actual user-visible activity and validate the selected SDK/product requirements. KikoFlu's manifest-only change is one layer, not a full implementation.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

ConnSSH returns channel success before its asynchronous native operation finishes; this is not proof of an accepted task. Etohos switches to a location mode/navigation callback: record that implementation without recommending location as a generic keepalive workaround. No reviewed source establishes guaranteed process survival.

## Verification

Observe actual native start/stop results, notifications/session controls, denial, disconnect, interruption and process teardown; verify all resources stop when their owning feature ends.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
